SiSMCaseTrackingStatusID.description: Gets or sets the ID of the case tracking status.

Name.description: Gets or sets the name of the case tracking status.

AvailableToEngineers.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the case tracking status is available to engineers.

AvailableToCustomers.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the case tracking status is available to customers.

Inactive.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the case tracking status is inactive.

Colour.description: Gets or sets the color of the case tracking status.

Name.description: Gets or sets the name of the servicecase type.

IsPreventativeMaintenance.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the case type is for preventative maintenance.

IsEnabled.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the case type is enabled.

allOf.description: The resource linked on an appointment

SiconAppointmentResourceID.description: The linked sicon appointment resource id

SiSMDocumentStatusID.description: The Document Status ID of the case

SiSMDocumentStatusName.description: The Document Status Name of the case (can be used if the Document Status ID is not available)

CaseTypeName.description: Case type name (can be used if case type ID is not available)

CustomerReference.description: Customer reference (Can be used instead of the SLCustomerAccountID)

InternalTeam.description: The internal team name for the case (can be used if the internal team ID is not available)

ExternalTeam.description: The external team name for the case (can be used if the external team ID is not available)

InternalTeamID.description: The internal team id for the case

ExternalTeamID.description: The external team id for the case

PriorityID.description: The priority ID of the case

PriorityName.description: The priority name of the case (can be used if the priority ID is not available)

SiconContractNumber.description: Sicon Contract Number. Can be used instead of the SiconContractID

SiconContractLineNumber.description: The Sicon Contract Line Number. Can be used instead of the SiconContractLineID provided that the SiconContractID or SiconContractNumber is also provided

SiconSubLocation.description: Sub location linked to a customer delivery address

TrackingNote.description: Represents a tracking note for a case in the service management system.

SiSMCaseTrackingNoteID.description: Gets or sets the ID of the tracking note.

SiSMCaseID.description: Gets or sets the ID of the case associated with the tracking note.

CreatedDateFormatted.description: Gets or sets the formatted created date of the tracking note.

Note.description: Gets or sets the note content of the tracking note.

User.description: Gets or sets the user who created the tracking note.

Time.description: Gets or sets the time of the tracking note.

Status.description: Gets or sets the status of the tracking note.

StatusID.description: Gets or sets the ID of the status of the tracking note.

SiconAppointmentID.description: Gets or sets the ID of the Sicon appointment associated with the tracking note.

VisibleToEngineer.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the tracking note is visible to the engineer.

VisibleToCustomer.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the tracking note is visible to the customer.

InternalStatus.description: Gets or sets the internal status of the tracking note.

InternalTeam.description: Gets or sets the internal team of the tracking note.

InternalTeamID.description: Gets or sets the ID of the internal team of the tracking note.

CaseOwner.description: Gets or sets the case owner of the tracking note.

CaseOwnerID.description: Gets or sets the ID of the case owner of the tracking note.

ExternalStatus.description: Gets or sets the external status of the tracking note.

ExternalTeam.description: Gets or sets the external team of the tracking note.

ExternalTeamID.description: Gets or sets the ID of the external team of the tracking note.

ReassignToSageUserNumber.description: Takes priority over the ReassignToSageUserName field
